## v2.2.4

The Linux AppImage now starts its launcher as a regular user: the packaged `AppRun` no longer requires root to execute. If an earlier AppImage reported `AppRun: Permission denied`, replace it with this release. The Linux build still uses Ubuntu 26.04; this fix does not lower the glibc requirement.

Other changes since 2.2.3 include native picture-in-picture playback, interface renderer selection and startup recovery overrides, improved high-DPI window sizing, and standalone diagnostics for investigating startup failures.
